expression: /* CB | Non-Anime Query Guard */ (queryType == 'movie' or queryType == 'series') and not isAnime ? streams : []

/* CB | Late Pack Fallback — hide multi-episode files only when 3 playable singles remain */ (queryType == 'series' and not isAnime and count(negate(merge(multiEpisode(streams),seasonPack(streams,'seasonPack')),streams)) >= 3) ? multiEpisode(streams) : []

/* CB | Late Pack Fallback — hide ambiguous season packs only when 3 playable singles remain */ (queryType == 'series' and not isAnime and count(negate(merge(multiEpisode(streams),seasonPack(streams,'seasonPack')),streams)) >= 3) ? seasonPack(streams,'onlySeasons') : []
